sections.heading: Chocolate Gift Box with Gold Divider Tray FAQ
sections.text: Questions Chocolate Gift Box with Gold Divider Tray FAQ How many chocolates can the box hold? The divider tray is cut from your chocolate dimensions, so the count follows your range: a single row, two rows or a full grid. Send the size of one piece and the number per box, and we lay out the tray and size the box around it. Is the divider tray food-grade? Yes. The gold divider tray in this style is a food-grade tray. Chocolates are usually placed in the compartments in paper cups or on a liner; tell us how you pack and we size the cavities for it. Magnetic lid or lift-off lid? The style shown has a magnetic lid that opens like a book. A lift-off lid and base suits stacked retail display. Both are rigid boxes and use the same tray. What is the minimum order? 100 pcs per custom size. A physical sample takes 3–5 business days and bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval; freight time comes on top. Do you fill the boxes with chocolate? No. We make and ship the empty boxes and trays; chocolates are packed at your kitchen or fulfilment site.
